kindHint.PPE_GARMENT: The sewn-in label of a PPE garment: CE mark, pictogram and class, maker, size.
kindHint.GLOVE_MARKING: A glove marked to EN 13594 with its level (1 or 2) and KP when the knuckles are protected.
kindHint.FIBRE_CARE: Fibres and care symbols only: no PPE marking (the PPE garment label carries it).
kindHint.PACKAGING: A label on the packaging, not sewn into the garment.

qrHint.NONE: The declaration travels with the goods: a QR is a choice, not a duty.
qrHint.BATCH_DOC: Each garment's QR opens the public page of its batch; the address is known when the batch is printed.
qrHint.STYLE_DOC: The QR opens the style's public page with its current declaration (a garment label usually names its batch).

list.phraseLibraryHint: The approved words of warnings, care and marking in every language (Rules & markets)

failed.artwork: Could not read the proofs waiting approval
failed.translations: Could not read the missing translations
failed.body: The list of labels is fine; this view needs one more read. Try again.

tile.artworkHint: Proofs a second person approves before they print
tile.translationsHint: A language or an approved warning a switched-on market needs

action.proofApproved: The approved proof, in a new tab
action.proofSample: No approved proof yet: the sample label as a PDF, in a new tab

marking.title: Kind and marking
marking.intro: What the label is, its QR to the declaration, the GPSR contact, the glove level and the class warnings it must carry.
marking.gpsrHint: Name, postal address and an e-mail or web address, one per line (Reg. (EU) 2023/988 art. 9). At most {max} characters.

problem.long: The GPSR contact is too long.

marking.failed: Could not read what the label must say
marking.senderWhy: The brand for a private-label style sold under its own name, our company otherwise (the economic operators of Rules & markets).
marking.qrBatchLater: A batch's address is made when its labels are printed.
marking.gloveNotGranted: No covering certificate names the level yet.

sender.none: No manufacturer is named for this style yet

warnings.title: Class warnings
warnings.none: This label needs no class warning.
warnings.draftTitle: Not printed yet: the warnings wait for the PPE consultant
warnings.draftBody: Their words come from the phrase library and stay drafts until a PPE consultant says yes to this label's texts (GATE-PPE-TEXTS).

composition.title: Composition computed from the BOM
composition.intro: The fibres of each part, from the materials of the style's BOM, in their official names (Reg. (EU) 1007/2011).
composition.noStyle: The label names no style: nothing to compute from.
composition.comparedWith: The checks compare the BOM with label {code} r{revision}, the one this revision names.
composition.comparedNone: Revision {revision} names no label yet: the checks compare the BOM with none.
composition.none: The BOM has no textile part yet.
composition.missing: Type these by hand or add the material's weight: {parts}.
composition.shareUnknown: The textile share is not known yet.
composition.shareApplies: Textile share {pct} % by weight: textile labelling applies.

rules.title: Marking and textile rules
rules.intro: Each rule in a sentence with its law. A failing rule blocks only the markets it concerns.
rules.failed: Could not read the marking rules
rules.noMarket: No market is switched on: the rules are checked for the label alone.

fix.waiting: Waits for the PPE consultant: nothing to fix here.
fix.style: On the style or its certificate.
fix.gates: Open the rule in Rules & markets

outcome.FAIL: Fails: fix it before the label prints.
outcome.UNKNOWN: Not known yet: it holds the print until it is.
outcome.NOT_APPLICABLE: Does not apply to this label.

textile.title: Textile, leather and origin
textile.failed: Could not read the textile checks

languages.title: Languages
languages.intro: Each phrase the label prints, with its approved words in every language the label prints and every language a switched-on market needs.
languages.rule: A missing translation of a warning, or a language the label does not print, blocks printing for the markets that need that language. Care and animal-origin words print from the label itself: Fill from the library copies the approved words into a draft.
languages.blockedLanguage: A market needs a language the label does not print: add it in a new revision.
languages.blockedPhrase: A warning has no approved words in a language a market needs: translate it and have it approved.
languages.noneBlocked: Nothing here keeps the label from printing.
languages.checksFailed: Could not read what the label must say
languages.failed: Could not read the phrase library
languages.empty: The label prints no phrase from the library
languages.emptyBody: No class warning, animal-origin phrase or care symbol yet.

translate.title: Translate: {phrase}
translate.intro: A proposal is saved when you leave its field and waits for a second person. Approving is explicit.
translate.hint: Saved when you leave the field.
translate.waiting: Proposed by {name}: waits for a second person.

artwork.title: Proofs
artwork.introApproved: The approved proof prints; a new one waits for a second person.
artwork.introNone: No proof is approved yet: where a requirement asks for approved artwork, the label does not print.
artwork.emptyBody: Add the label's proof as a PDF or a picture: a second person approves it.
artwork.emptyBodyView: A person who keeps labels adds the proof.
artwork.openN: Open proof v{n} in a new tab
artwork.noFile: The proof's file can no longer be read
artwork.workOrdersIntro: Each work order released with this revision follows the proof in force at its first print: reprints use the same.
artwork.noWorkOrders: No work order is released with this revision yet.

problem.type: A proof is a PDF or a picture (PNG, JPEG, WebP).
problem.size: A proof is at most 25 MB.

signoff.title: Approval
signoff.whoMay: A person who approves label artwork, other than its author
signoff.ruleYours: You made this proof: someone else approves it.

approve.title: Approve proof v{n} of {code} r{revision}
approve.replaces: The proof approved now (v{n}) is retired with this approval: one proof prints per label revision.
approve.first: It becomes the proof the label prints.

add.title: Add a proof to {code} r{revision}
add.intro: The proof is kept as a file of this label and waits for a second person's approval.
add.hint: A PDF or a picture, at most 25 MB.
add.noteHint: What changed, for the person who approves it.

retireProof.title: Retire proof v{n}
retireProof.approved: It no longer prints: until another is approved, the label has no approved proof. Work orders that printed with it keep it.
retireProof.draft: It goes out of the way and is kept on record.

held.busy: Wait: the last change is being saved.
held.brandLater: Brand approval through the portal comes later; record the brand's written yes in the proof's note.
held.noFile: The proof's file can no longer be read.
held.noOperator: No economic operator row names the manufacturer: add one in Rules & markets › Operators.
held.nothingComputed: The BOM gave no part with fibres.
held.nothingToApprove: None of the selected phrases has a proposal you may approve.
held.rowNothingToApprove: No proposal here that you may approve.
held.nothingToFill: The label already holds the library's approved words.
held.notInLibrary: This phrase is not in the library: add it in Rules & markets › Phrases.
held.frozen: Active labels are never edited: a change is a new revision.
held.notDraft: Only a proof waiting approval is approved.
held.ownProof: You made this proof: a second person approves it.
held.approveRight: You do not approve label artwork.
held.kept: Approved and retired proofs are kept, never removed.
held.phrasesManage: You do not keep the phrase library.
held.ownProposal: You proposed it: someone else approves it.
held.source: This is the phrase's own language.

problem.conflict: Someone changed it meanwhile: read again and retry.
problem.invalid: Not saved: something in it is not valid.

depth.needStyle: No style names this label yet: the rules are checked for a style.

done.filled_one: {count} text filled from the library: Save to keep it.
done.filled_other: {count} texts filled from the library: Save to keep them.
done.proofAdded: Proof v{n} added: it waits for a second person.
done.proofApproved: Proof v{n} approved: it prints now.

styleComposition.intro: Revision {revision}, size {size}: the fibres of each part in their official names.
